key_findings: MSD199 is a potent selective human Nav1.8 inhibitor (IC50 4.7 nM) with a roughly 1000-fold rightward potency shift at rat Nav1.8 (4826 nM), restored in humanized Nav1.8 rat DRG neurons (5.6 nM).
In humanized Nav1.8 rats MSD199 dose-dependently blocked capsaicin-induced nocifensive behavior and reversed CFA thermal hyperalgesia and SNL mechanical allodynia.
